title: Select card title
summary: Use a class selector to style a specified title.
tasks: Use .card-title to select the course card title.
Set the title color to #125a46 and the font size to 24px. Keep the original style of "Instructions for Use".
hint: Add a period before the class name, for example .example { color: navy; }.
goal: Among the titles using the same tag, find the course title you want to adjust by its class name.

example.note: In the reservation list, add class="seat-available" to the entries of available seats. This rule will unify their text colors.
